units.source_text: 谁知女人仿佛受到刺激一般，忽地弯下腰跑了过去，看样子又回到崖下，继续干她的活去了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the woman seemed to be stirred into action; she suddenly bent down and ran off, apparently returning to the foot of the cliff to continue her work.

units.source_text: 他觉得那动作简直就像斑蝥耍的花招似的。

en.t: To him, the movement looked exactly like some trick played by a blister beetle.
